# Dark-Ero

> Dark-Ero is an 18+ English directory of adult websites. Category lists link to each site's official URL. The site also publishes reviews and safety guides. It does not host adult media.

- [Stories and audio](https://www.dark-ero.store/category/stories-audio/): erotic fiction, ASMR and voice

- [Live cams](https://www.dark-ero.store/category/live-cams/): cam sites

- [Feet marketplaces](https://www.dark-ero.store/category/sell-feet-pics/): platforms for selling feet pics
- [Rated](https://www.dark-ero.store/category/rated/): SpicyRanked comparisons, best lists and reviews
